recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-11407 unless FM wants to define new requirements beyond the existing R4/current Batches section and Claim $submit operation description.
issue_request: FHIR-11407 was a Published FHIR-core Financial Management change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking to add a section detailing Batch Claim submissions. Jira records a Not Persuasive resolution with future STU R4 consideration, followed by a comment that the concerns were addressed in the materials published in R4.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11407 was found. The relevant source appears to have been applied implicitly by f4c5e91b2ad6dc71145fc8b6f7942413c4eca3cd, which added the Financial module Batches section in November 2018 before R4, with QA wording corrections in e763f3562d184162254f08f9234dbd2d650941a3.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists financial-module.html as the active Financial module page, and current source/financial-module.html contains the Batches section explaining individual eClaim requests/responses and eClaim batches as FHIR Bundles. source/claim/operationdefinition-Claim-submit.xml also allows a Bundle containing a batch of Claim resources. The R4 published financial-module.html contains the same Batches section. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision; Zulip only surfaced the tracker bot announcement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current specification already satisfies the issue request and a source edit would only duplicate existing guidance.

related_jiras.note: The implementation commit that introduced the batch section was labeled GF #17980, but FHIR-17980 concerns links to financial-resource status documentation rather than batch-claim submissions and was not decided here.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final issue disposition and the need to verify whether R4/current source already contains the requested section.

evidence_items.summary: The Claim submit operation description allows a Bundle containing a batch of Claim resources.

evidence_items.summary: 2018 commits added and then QA-corrected the Financial module batch section before R4 publication.

checks: git log --fixed-strings --grep='Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-11407' on the combined branch returned no existing commit before publishing.

rg -i 'Batch Claim|batch claim|Claim submission|Claim submissions|batch.*Claim|Claim.*batch' source found the Financial module Batches section, financial resource links to #batch, and Claim $submit batch support.
git blame and git show identified f4c5e91b2ad6dc71145fc8b6f7942413c4eca3cd as the commit adding the Batches section and e763f3562d184162254f08f9234dbd2d650941a3 as the QA correction.
curl -fsSL https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/financial-module.html | grep -i 'Batches - Handling multiple eClaim requests' confirmed the R4 published page contains the section.
